name: 60490 · Bolingbrook, IL
findings: ZIP 60490 (Bolingbrook) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60490 (Bolingbrook) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
